en: The single trait that separates those who get rich and those who don't is their relationship to fear.
zh: 区分一个人能不能变富的单一特质，就是他和恐惧之间的关系。

en: Whether fear builds you up or breaks you down will determine the trajectory of your entire life.
zh: 恐惧是成就你，还是击垮你，将决定你整个人生的走向。

en: Because fear, which simply means a perceived threat, is a meta-emotion.
zh: 因为恐惧，简单来说就是一种感知到的威胁，它是一种元情绪。

en: Meaning it's the sole glue that holds together all other forms of negative emotion.
zh: 也就是说，它是把其他所有负面情绪黏合在一起的唯一胶水。

en: Whether it's anxiety, or stress, doubt, anger, sadness.
zh: 不管是焦虑、压力、怀疑、愤怒，还是悲伤。

en: None of these emotions would exist without the perceived threat that fear includes.
zh: 如果没有恐惧中包含的那种“感知到的威胁”，这些情绪都不会存在。

en: And so fear is this mastermind underneath all forms of emotional resistance.
zh: 所以，恐惧就是隐藏在所有情绪阻力之下的幕后主谋。

en: And so when you fix your relationship to it.
zh: 因此，当你修正了自己和恐惧的关系时。

en: those downstream negative emotions, which are holding you back.
zh: 那些一直阻碍你的下游负面情绪。

en: lose their grip over your actions.
zh: 就会失去对你行动的控制力。

en: But what most people completely misinterpret about fear is that it is an illusion.
zh: 但大多数人对恐惧最大的误解，就是以为它是真实的，其实它是一种幻象。

en: Fear stands for false evidence appearing real F-E-A-R.
zh: Fear 这个词代表 false evidence appearing real，也就是“看起来真实的虚假证据”，F-E-A-R。

en: Because for thousands of years certainly fear served us.
zh: 因为在几千年的时间里，恐惧当然曾经保护过我们。

en: It kept us alive in an environment where we would encounter overwhelming physical danger.
zh: 在一个会遇到巨大身体危险的环境里，它让我们活了下来。

en: But that system has not been updated for the modern context.
zh: 但这套系统并没有为现代环境更新。

en: And so we get the same feeling when we're sending an important email.
zh: 所以，当我们发送一封重要邮件时，也会产生同样的感觉。

en: as if there were a saber-tooth tiger in the same room.
zh: 就好像房间里真的有一只剑齿虎一样。

en: The feeling is deeply maladaptive.
zh: 这种感觉是高度不适应现代生活的。

en: And the crucial point here is that.
zh: 而这里最关键的一点是。

en: every opportunity you will encounter in your life.
zh: 你人生中遇到的每一个机会。

en: is on the other side of a feeling that is not even real.
zh: 都在一种甚至并不真实的感觉之后。

en: It's a Fugazi.
zh: 它就是个 Fugazi。

en: So when you internalize that fear, it's a phantom.
zh: 所以当你真正内化这一点：恐惧只是一个幽灵。

en: It's a predictive error.
zh: 它是一种预测错误。

en: It's a broken signal that points to absolutely nothing.
zh: 它是一个坏掉的信号，实际上什么也指向不了。

en: You gain the single greatest competitive advantage.
zh: 你就获得了最强大的单一竞争优势。

en: to getting rich and achieving success.
zh: 让你更容易变富，并取得成功。

en: because it allows you to just feel fear and do it anyway.
zh: 因为这会让你能够感受到恐惧，但依然去做。

en: And so when you encounter fear, when you feel it throughout your life,
zh: 所以，当你在生活中遇到恐惧、感受到恐惧时，

en: deploy this three-step protocol.
zh: 就使用这套三步流程。

en: Step one, when you feel the emotion.
zh: 第一步，当你感受到这种情绪时。

en: ask yourself, where is the tiger?
zh: 问问自己：老虎在哪里？

en: Where is the physical danger?
zh: 真正的身体危险在哪里？

en: If there is none, you know Firstly.
zh: 如果没有，那你首先就知道。

en: that this feeling is a Fugazi.
zh: 这种感觉就是一个 Fugazi。

en: It's a fiction It's not real.
zh: 它是虚构的，它不是真的。

en: And secondly, that the action you're avoiding on the other side of that fear is exactly
zh: 其次，你因为恐惧而逃避的那个行动，恰恰就是

en: where the most amount of growth is found.
zh: 成长最集中的地方。

en: Step two, set an alarm for 24 hours time and do the action anyway.
zh: 第二步，设置一个24小时后的闹钟，然后无论如何都去做那件事。

en: We do not negotiate with things that aren't real.
zh: 我们不和不存在的东西谈判。

en: And so send the email, take the call, have the conversation.
zh: 所以，发出那封邮件，接起那个电话，进行那场对话。

en: whatever it is, just do it.
zh: 不管是什么，直接去做。

en: Step three is now when that alarm goes off in 24 hours time,
zh: 第三步，当24小时后的闹钟响起时，

en: after you take the action, do a reflection or an audit on that fear.
zh: 在你采取行动之后，对这份恐惧做一次复盘或审计。

en: Ask yourself, did the thing that it said was so bad.
zh: 问问自己，它当初说得那么糟糕的那件事，

en: was it actually that bad?
zh: 真的有那么糟糕吗？

en: Did I encounter any physical threats?
zh: 我有没有遇到任何身体上的威胁？

en: Am I okay?
zh: 我现在还好吗？

en: Right? Because when we do this reflection, we accumulate a compelling library.
zh: 对吧？因为当我们做这种复盘时，我们会积累起一个很有说服力的证据库。

en: of evidence that allows us to, allows our mind to invert the meaning
zh: 这些证据会让我们，也会让我们的大脑，重新反转它赋予恐惧的意义。

en: that it assigns fear.
zh: 也就是它给恐惧贴上的那个意义。

en: because we're compiling evidence that the signal of fear is wrong.
zh: 因为我们正在收集证据，证明恐惧这个信号是错的。

en: It's maladaptive. And so I call this the fear feedback cycle.
zh: 它并不适应当下。所以我把它叫作“恐惧反馈循环”。

en: And so when you repeat this cycle of reflecting on fear 24 hours after you take action,
zh: 因此，当你在采取行动24小时后，反复进行这种关于恐惧的复盘循环时，

en: you build and accumulate enough evidence to change the signal from something you avoid into something you actively pursue.
zh: 你会建立并积累足够多的证据，把这个信号从你逃避的东西，变成你主动追逐的东西。

en: Fear becomes the compass directing all of your action.
zh: 恐惧会变成指引你所有行动的指南针。

en: from something that used to break you down into the single most potent indicator.
zh: 它会从过去那个击垮你的东西，变成最有力的单一指标。

en: telling you which direction you need to go in to succeed.
zh: 告诉你要朝哪个方向走，才能取得成功。

en: Now, of course, fear is a much smaller component in a much larger system that is running your entire life on autopilot.
zh: 当然，恐惧只是一个更大系统中的很小一部分，而这个系统正在自动驾驶你的人生。
